models.name: User
models.definition:
id             String   @id @default(uuid())
  name           String
  phone          String   @unique
  email          String?  @unique
  passwordHash   String
  role           Role
  isActive       Boolean  @default(true)
  /// Telegram bot bilan bog'langan chat (bir chat — bitta foydalanuvchi)
  telegramChatId String?  @unique
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt

  studentProfile   StudentProfile?
  parentLinks      ParentStudent[]     @relation("ParentLinks")
  teachingGroups   Group[]             @relation("GroupTeacher")
  refreshTokens    RefreshToken[]
  desktopAuthCodes DesktopAuthCode[]
  notifications    Notification[]
  articles         Article[]
  videoPurchases   VideoPurchase[]
  mockPurchases    MockPurchase[]
  telegramTokens   TelegramLinkToken[]

  @@index([role])

models.name: TelegramLinkToken
models.definition:
id        String    @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String
  tokenHash String    @unique
  expiresAt DateTime
  usedAt    DateTime?
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])

models.name: RefreshToken
models.definition:
id        String    @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String
  tokenHash String    @unique
  familyId  String    @default("")
  expiresAt DateTime
  revokedAt DateTime?
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([familyId])

models.name: DesktopAuthCode
models.definition:
id            String    @id @default(uuid())
  userId        String
  codeHash      String    @unique
  codeChallenge String
  deviceId      String
  state         String
  expiresAt     DateTime
  usedAt        DateTime?
  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([expiresAt])

models.name: StudentProfile
models.definition:
userId            String        @id
  availablePrograms ExamProgram[] @default([IELTS])
  activeProgram     ExamProgram?  @default(IELTS)
  isApproved        Boolean       @default(false) // "Tasdiqlangan o'quv markaz o'quvchisi"
  groupId           String?
  currentPoints     Int           @default(0)
  linkCode          String        @unique // ota-ona farzandini shu kod bilan bog'laydi
  createdAt         DateTime      @default(now())

  // --- Oylik o'yin tizimi ---
  /// currentPoints qaysi oyga tegishli ("YYYY-MM"). Oy o'zgarsa ball qayta boshlanadi.
  pointsPeriod  String?
  /// Shu oyda chegara ballga yetib o'yinga qo'shilganmi (oy oxirigacha "yopishqoq")
  gameQualified Boolean   @default(false)
  qualifiedAt   DateTime?

  user           User                   @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  group          Group?                 @relation(fields: [groupId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  parents        ParentStudent[]
  attendance     Attendance[]
  payments       Payment[]
  pointsLog      PointsLog[]
  attempts       TestAttempt[]
  pointsArchive  MonthlyPointsArchive[]
  mockAttempts   MockAttempt[]
  assessmentJobs AssessmentJob[]

  @@index([groupId])

models.name: MonthlyPointsArchive
models.definition:
id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  studentId String
  year      Int
  month     Int // 1..12
  points    Int
  qualified Boolean  @default(false) // o'sha oyda o'yinga qo'shilgan edimi
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  student StudentProfile @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [userId], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([studentId, year, month])
  @@index([year, month])

models.name: ParentStudent
models.definition:
parentUserId String
  studentId    String
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())

  parent  User           @relation("ParentLinks", fields: [parentUserId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  student StudentProfile @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [userId], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([parentUserId, studentId])

models.name: Group
models.definition:
id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  name      String
  teacherId String?
  schedule  Json? // [{day:"mon", startTime:"14:00", endTime:"16:00"}]
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  teacher    User?            @relation("GroupTeacher", fields: [teacherId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  students   StudentProfile[]
  attendance Attendance[]

models.name: Attendance
models.definition:
id         String          @id @default(uuid())
  studentId  String
  groupId    String
  date       DateTime        @db.Date
  state      AttendanceState
  markedById String
  createdAt  DateTime        @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime        @updatedAt

  student StudentProfile @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [userId], onDelete: Cascade)
  group   Group          @relation(fields: [groupId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([studentId, groupId, date])
  @@index([groupId, date])

models.name: Payment
models.definition:
id         String        @id @default(uuid())
  studentId  String
  month      Int // 1..12
  year       Int
  state      PaymentState
  amount     Int           @default(0) // so'mda
  method     PaymentMethod @default(manual)
  note       String?
  markedById String?
  createdAt  DateTime      @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime      @updatedAt

  student StudentProfile @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [userId], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([studentId, month, year])
  @@index([year, month])

models.name: PointsLog
models.definition:
id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  studentId String
  change    Int
  reason    String
  byUserId  String? // null = tizim (masalan boshlang'ich ball)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  student StudentProfile @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [userId], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([studentId, createdAt])

models.name: Test
models.definition:
id                    String   @id @default(uuid())
  type                  TestType
  title                 String
  level                 String? // masalan "B2", "Academic"
  isDemo                Boolean  @default(false) // mehmonlar ko'ra oladigan demo test
  isActive              Boolean  @default(true)
  durationMinutes       Int?
  sectionQuestionCounts Json? // {"listening":10,"reading":10} — random tanlab olinadigan savollar soni
  createdAt             DateTime @default(now())

  questions Question[]
  attempts  TestAttempt[]

models.name: Question
models.definition:
id            String       @id @default(uuid())
  testId        String
  section       TestSection
  type          QuestionType
  prompt        String
  options       Json? // string[] — multiple_choice uchun
  correctAnswer String? // avtomatik baholanadiganlar uchun; variantlar "|" bilan ajratiladi
  maxScore      Int          @default(1)
  // Comfortable testing: audio/passage/instructions (Survey about shopping kabi)
  // Migration: npx prisma migrate dev --name add_question_media_fields
  // Agar DB allaqachon mavjud bo'lsa, quyidagi maydonlar nullable — migrate xavfsiz.
  audioUrl      String? // storage kaliti, masalan "tests/<uuid>.mp3" — streaming via GET /tests/questions/:id/audio
  passageText   String? // Reading/Listening uzun matn (masalan Survey matni)
  instructions  String? // "Listen and answer..." kabi guruh ko'rsatmasi
  createdAt     DateTime     @default(now())

  test    Test     @relation(fields: [testId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  answers Answer[]

  @@index([testId, section])

models.name: TestAttempt
models.definition:
id             String        @id @default(uuid())
  studentId      String
  testId         String
  status         AttemptStatus @default(in_progress)
  questionOrder  Json // string[] — shu urinish uchun random tanlangan savollar tartibi
  autoScore      Float?
  manualScore    Float?
  totalScore     Float?
  antiCheatCount Int           @default(0)
  startedAt      DateTime      @default(now())
  finishedAt     DateTime?

  student     StudentProfile   @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [userId], onDelete: Cascade)
  test        Test             @relation(fields: [testId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  answers     Answer[]
  cheatEvents AntiCheatEvent[]

  @@index([studentId])
  @@index([status])

models.name: AntiCheatEvent
models.definition:
id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  attemptId String
  event     String // masalan "tab_switch"
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  attempt TestAttempt @relation(fields: [attemptId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([attemptId])

models.name: Answer
models.definition:
id         String   @id @default(uuid())
  attemptId  String
  questionId String
  answer     String
  score      Float?
  isGraded   Boolean  @default(false)
  gradedById String? // Writing/Speaking uchun baholagan o'qituvchi
  comment    String?
  // Exam-time reading aids: highlighted passage snippets + private note.
  // Stored on the passage-owner question of each part (see saveMarks).
  highlights Json? // string[] — ajratilgan matn parchalari
  note       String? // shaxsiy eslatma (2000 belgigacha)
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt

  attempt  TestAttempt @relation(fields: [attemptId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  question Question    @relation(fields: [questionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([attemptId, questionId])

models.name: VideoLesson
models.definition:
id                String   @id @default(uuid())
  title             String
  description       String?
  price             Int      @default(0) // so'mda; 0 = bepul
  isFreeForApproved Boolean  @default(true) // tasdiqlangan o'quvchiga bepulmi
  fileKey           String // storage ichidagi nisbiy yo'l
  mimeType          String?
  thumbnailKey      String?
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now())

  purchases VideoPurchase[]

models.name: VideoPurchase
models.definition:
id            String         @id @default(uuid())
  userId        String
  videoId       String
  status        PurchaseStatus @default(pending_confirmation)
  method        PaymentMethod  @default(manual)
  confirmedById String?
  createdAt     DateTime       @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime       @updatedAt

  user  User        @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  video VideoLesson @relation(fields: [videoId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, videoId])

models.name: Article
models.definition:
id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  title     String
  body      String
  category  String
  tags      String[]
  authorId  String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  author User? @relation(fields: [authorId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([category])

models.name: Teacher
GalleryImage
Notification
models.definition:
id        String           @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String
  type      NotificationType
  text      String
  read      Boolean          @default(false)
  createdAt DateTime         @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, read])

models.name: AuditLog
models.definition:
id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String?
  action    String // masalan "payment.set", "points.adjust", "user.deactivate"
  entity    String
  entityId  String?
  oldValue  Json?
  newValue  Json?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([entity, createdAt])
  @@index([userId])

models.name: Setting
models.definition:
key   String @id
  value Json

models.name: MockExam
models.definition:
id                     String                @id @default(uuid())
  assessmentPolicy       AssessmentPolicyMode?
  speakingProfileVersion String?
  specificationVersion   String?
  type                   MockExamType
  title                  String
  description            String?
  level                  String? // masalan "Academic", "B1-C1"
  practiceLevel          PracticeLevel?
  isPublished            Boolean               @default(false)
  isDemo                 Boolean               @default(false) // mehmonlar/ota-ona ko'radigan demo
  // --- Pullik kirish (video modeli kabi; oddiy userlar sotib olib ishlatadi) ---
  price                  Int                   @default(0) // so'mda; 0 = bepul
  isFreeForApproved      Boolean               @default(true) // tasdiqlangan markaz o'quvchisiga bepulmi
  createdById            String? // yaratgan admin/teacher (User.id)
  createdAt              DateTime              @default(now())
  updatedAt              DateTime              @updatedAt
  // --- AI JSON import (additive; legacy imtihonlarda default qiymatlar) ---
  profile                String                @default("practice") // practice | full_mock
  blueprintRef           String? // full_mock tasdiqlangan blueprint havolasi (ixtiyoriy)
  contentVersion         Int                   @default(1) // optimistic concurrency (teacher save bilan)

  sections  MockSection[]
  attempts  MockAttempt[]
  purchases MockPurchase[]
  imports   MockExamImport[]

  @@index([type])

models.name: MockExamImport
models.definition:
id                 String   @id @default(uuid())
  createdById        String // session egasi — AI JSON yaratuvchini tanlay olmaydi
  packageId          String
  revision           Int
  schemaVersion      String   @default("1.0")
  profile            String   @default("practice")
  rawChecksum        String // kelgan JSON ning canonical checksum
  normalizedChecksum String // server normalizatsiyasidan keyingi checksum
  validatedChecksum  String // dry-run da qaytarilgan checksum (commit tasdig'i)
  examId             String
  createdAt          DateTime @default(now())

  exam       MockExam                @relation(fields: [examId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  sourceMaps MockImportSourceMap[]
  issues     MockImportReviewIssue[]

  @@unique([createdById, packageId, revision])
  @@index([examId])

models.name: MockImportSourceMap
models.definition:
id        String @id @default(uuid())
  importId  String
  kind      String // section | group | question | media
  sourceKey String
  entityId  String

  import MockExamImport @relation(fields: [importId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([importId, kind, sourceKey])
  @@index([importId])

models.name: MockImportReviewIssue
models.definition:
id           String    @id @default(uuid())
  importId     String
  sourceKey    String?
  entityKind   String?
  code         String
  path         String
  message      String
  status       String    @default("open") // open | resolved
  resolvedById String?
  resolvedAt   DateTime?
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now())

  import MockExamImport @relation(fields: [importId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([importId, status])

models.name: MockStagedMedia
models.definition:
id              String    @id @default(uuid())
  ownerId         String // yuklagan staff (User.id)
  storageKey      String    @unique // mock/ ichidagi opaque kalit
  fileName        String // asl basename (ko'rsatish uchun)
  mimeType        String?
  sizeBytes       Int
  checksum        String // sha256 (file content)
  kind            String // audio | image
  expiresAt       DateTime
  claimedAt       DateTime?
  claimedImportId String?
  createdAt       DateTime  @default(now())

  @@index([ownerId])
  @@index([expiresAt])

models.name: MockPurchase
models.definition:
id            String         @id @default(uuid())
  userId        String
  examId        String
  status        PurchaseStatus @default(pending_confirmation)
  method        PaymentMethod  @default(manual)
  amount        Int            @default(0)
  confirmedById String?
  createdAt     DateTime       @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime       @updatedAt

  user User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  exam MockExam @relation(fields: [examId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, examId])
  @@index([status])

models.name: MockSection
models.definition:
id              String    @id @default(uuid())
  examId          String
  skill           MockSkill
  title           String?
  sortOrder       Int       @default(0)
  durationMinutes Int? // bo'lim vaqti (IELTS: L~30, R~60, W~60)
  instructions    String?

  exam   MockExam            @relation(fields: [examId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  groups MockQuestionGroup[]

  @@unique([examId, skill])
  @@index([examId, sortOrder])

models.name: MockQuestionGroup
models.definition: id String @id @default(uuid()) sectionId String sortOrder Int @default(0) title String? instructions String? // "Complete the notes. Write ONE WORD ONLY." passageText String? // Reading matni / Listening transkripti contentHtml String? // Sanitized rich document; gaps are audioScript String? // Staff-only sanitized transcript/review material contentLayout String? // document | table | notes | summary | sentences optionsReusable Boolean? // null keeps legacy clients; false requires one-use matching audioKey String? // Listening audio (storage kaliti) imageKey String? // Map/diagram labelling uchun rasm // Versioned Multilevel keeps assessment caps and shared task stimuli at the // semantic part/task level. Legacy IELTS continues to use question.points. maxScore Int? stimulusRef String? // --- IELTS full-test (v2026.1): Listening 4 part, dynamic audio muddati --- partNumber Int? // Listening uchun 1..4 (Reading/Writing da null) audioPlayLimit Int @default(1) // exam rejimda 1, practice da cheksiz (service tekshiradi) audioDurationSec Int? // audio davomiyligi (sekund); deadline = duration + 120s review createdAt DateTime @default(now()) section MockSection @relation(fields: [sectionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade) questions MockQuestion[] @@index([sectionId, sortOrder])

models.name: MockQuestion
models.definition:
id               String           @id @default(uuid())
  groupId          String
  number           Int // imtihondagi savol raqami (1..40)
  sortOrder        Int              @default(0)
  type             MockQuestionType
  prompt           String
  options          Json? // multiple_choice/matching uchun: string[]
  correctAnswers   Json? // string[] — qabul qilinadigan to'g'ri javoblar (auto-baholash)
  points           Int              @default(1)
  wordLimit        Int? // "NO MORE THAN X WORDS" cheklovi (ixtiyoriy)
  answerRule       String? // ONE_WORD | ONE_WORD_AND_OR_NUMBER; null keeps legacy IELTS normalization
  acceptedVariants Json? // British/American imlo variantlari: string[] (masalan ["colour","color"])
  createdAt        DateTime         @default(now())

  group   MockQuestionGroup @relation(fields: [groupId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  answers MockAnswer[]

  @@index([groupId, sortOrder])

models.name: MockAttempt
models.definition:
id                     String            @id @default(uuid())
  speakingProfileVersion String?
  specificationVersion   String?
  scoreMethod            String?
  scoreVersion           String?
  standardScores         Json?
  overallScore           Float?
  mediaState             Json?
  examId                 String
  studentId              String
  status                 MockAttemptStatus @default(in_progress)
  startedAt              DateTime          @default(now())
  submittedAt            DateTime?
  finishedAt             DateTime?
  rawScores              Json? // {"listening":{"score":32,"max":40},...}
  sectionBands           Json? // {"listening":7,"reading":6.5,...}
  overallBand            Float? // IELTS umumiy band (0-9)
  cefrLevel              String? // Multilevel uchun CEFR (A1..C1)
  antiCheatCount         Int               @default(0)
  mode                   MockAttemptMode   @default(practice) // practice=vaqtsiz, timed=vaqtli
  deadlineAt             DateTime? // timed rejimda tugash vaqti (startedAt + davomiylik)
  annotations            Json? // o'quvchining highlight/eslatmalari (frontend uchun saqlanadi)
  // --- IELTS full-test flow (v2026.1): L→R→W ketma-ket, server-soat ---
  flowMode               String? // "full_test" | "single_skill" (null = single_skill, eski yozuvlar)
  currentSkill           MockSkill? // full_test da joriy bo'lim (listening→reading→writing)
  sectionDeadlines       Json? // {"listening": ISO, "reading": ISO, "writing": ISO}
  overallDeadlineAt      DateTime? // full_test umumiy deadline (oxirgi bo'lim tugashi)
  audioPlays             Json? // {"groupId": count} — Listening once-only nazorati
  submittedSections      Json? // ["listening", ...] — yakunlangan bo'limlar

  exam           MockExam         @relation(fields: [examId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  student        StudentProfile   @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [userId], onDelete: Cascade)
  answers        MockAnswer[]
  cheatEvents    MockCheatEvent[]
  assessmentJobs AssessmentJob[]

  @@index([studentId])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([examId])

models.name: MockAnswer
models.definition:
id           String   @id @default(uuid())
  attemptId    String
  questionId   String
  response     String   @default("") // o'quvchi javobi (matn)
  audioKey     String? // Speaking javobi — yuklangan audio (storage kaliti)
  isCorrect    Boolean? // auto-baholangan savollar uchun
  score        Float?
  isGraded     Boolean  @default(false)
  gradedById   String? // writing/speaking ni baholagan o'qituvchi (User.id)
  feedback     String?
  rubricScores Json? // 4 mezon: writing {TA,CC,LR,GRA} / speaking {fluency,lexical,grammar,pronun} 0..9
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt

  attempt  MockAttempt  @relation(fields: [attemptId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  question MockQuestion @relation(fields: [questionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([attemptId, questionId])
  @@index([attemptId])

models.name: MockCheatEvent
models.definition:
id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  attemptId String
  event     String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  attempt MockAttempt @relation(fields: [attemptId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([attemptId])

models.name: AssessmentJob
models.definition:
id                   String                 @id @default(uuid())
  attemptId            String
  studentId            String
  program              String
  skill                MockSkill
  inputHash            String
  inputSnapshot        Json
  generation           Int                    @default(0)
  rubricVersion        String
  promptVersion        String
  policyMode           AssessmentPolicyMode
  status               AssessmentJobStatus    @default(PENDING)
  version              Int                    @default(1)
  attemptCount         Int                    @default(0)
  leaseToken           String?
  leaseExpiresAt       DateTime?
  retryAt              DateTime?
  startedAt            DateTime?
  completedAt          DateTime?
  failureCode          String?
  selectedEvaluationId String?
  aiScore              Float?
  teacherScore         Float?
  finalScore           Float?
  finalScoreSource     AssessmentScoreSource?
  confidence           Float?
  finalResult          Json?
  approvedFeedback     Json?
  createdAt            DateTime               @default(now())
  updatedAt            DateTime               @updatedAt

  attempt     MockAttempt            @relation(fields: [attemptId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  student     StudentProfile         @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [userId], onDelete: Cascade)
  evaluations AssessmentEvaluation[]
  transcripts SpeechTranscript[]

  @@unique([attemptId, skill, inputHash, generation])
  @@index([status, retryAt, createdAt])
  @@index([attemptId, skill, createdAt])
  @@index([studentId, createdAt])

models.name: AssessmentEvaluation
models.definition:
id            String               @id @default(uuid())
  jobId         String
  role          String
  attemptNumber Int
  inputHash     String
  status        AssessmentCallStatus @default(STARTED)
  provider      String
  model         String
  result        Json?
  confidence    Float?
  inputTokens   Int?
  outputTokens  Int?
  latencyMs     Int?
  failureCode   String?
  uncertain     Boolean              @default(false)
  startedAt     DateTime             @default(now())
  completedAt   DateTime?

  job AssessmentJob @relation(fields: [jobId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([jobId, role, attemptNumber])
  @@index([jobId, status])

models.name: SpeechTranscript
models.definition:
id                    String               @id @default(uuid())
  jobId                 String
  questionId            String
  audioHash             String
  status                AssessmentCallStatus @default(STARTED)
  attemptNumber         Int                  @default(1)
  text                  String?
  segments              Json?
  confidence            Float?
  provider              String
  model                 String
  durationMs            Int?
  pronunciationEvidence String               @default("UNAVAILABLE")
  failureCode           String?
  uncertain             Boolean              @default(false)
  startedAt             DateTime             @default(now())
  completedAt           DateTime?

  job AssessmentJob @relation(fields: [jobId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([jobId, questionId, attemptNumber])
  @@index([audioHash, status])
